stem.text: What is the reason for the increase in red blood cells in humans at high altitudes?

A.text: to compensate for the low percentage saturation of haemoglobin

B.text: to enable haemoglobin to unload more oxygen in the tissues by the Bohr effect

C.text: to ensure that haemoglobin is almost 90% saturated when it reaches the tissues

D.text: to increase the number of mitochondria in the blood for ATP production
